data.title: 泽塔 · 情报的奖赏
data.description: 泽塔单膝跪着汇报完最后一处据点的情报，风衣还带着夜里的寒气。暗影大人听完，只伸手把她拉进了怀里。风衣散开，战服的拉链被一路拉到底，冷面谍报员的呼吸第一次乱了方寸——「……这也是……任务的一部分吗……」她问得一本正经，手却先一步攥紧了他的衣襟。
data.location: 阴影庭园地下谒见厅·深夜
data.action: 被拉坐在暗影腿上，风衣敞开，战服拉链拉开，攥紧对方衣襟
data.lighting: cold blue magic-stone light of the audience chamber
data.promptProse: Kneeling to deliver her final report, adult Zeta is pulled into Shadow's lap instead. Her trench coat falls open, her suit unzipped to the bottom — the Garden's coldest spy forgets every word of her report.
data.animaCaption: The report was flawless. Its delivery was not — Zeta’s voice breaks first, and she stops pretending it is business.
